author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
In the age of AI, your worth is not how much work you have done.  It is how many problems you can solve that are not solvable by AI alone.

AI can do 90% of the work, but the last 10% determines success or failure.

You shouldn't and you can't compete with AI, all you need is to be the human who takes care of the last 10%.
